description_en: Requests a temporary OSS PUT upload URL. Complete the PUT upload before the URL expires, then pass the returned FileId to the ReferenceFileIds parameter of CreateSemanticJob
description_zh: 申请临时 OSS PUT 上传地址后，先在有效期内完成 PUT 上传，再将返回的 FileId 填入 CreateSemanticJob 的 ReferenceFileIds
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public upload-semantic-file --file-name reference.pdf --content-type application/pdf --size-bytes 1024 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadSemanticFile

parameters.help_en: The original file name of the reference file to upload. Maximum length: 255 characters. When singleTableFile uses a FileId, only CSV or XLSX files are supported
parameters.help_zh: 待上传参考文件的原始文件名，最长 255 个字符。singleTableFile 使用 FileId 时仅支持 CSV 或 XLSX 文件
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The MIME type of the object to upload. Maximum length: 128 characters. This value is included in the UploadUrl signature. Use the same Content-Type when performing the PUT request
parameters.help_zh: 上传对象的 MIME 类型，最长 128 个字符。该值会参与 UploadUrl 的签名，执行 PUT 时应使用相同的 Content-Type
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.help_en: The size of the file to upload, in bytes. This value is recorded as attachment metadata. Specify the actual file size
parameters.help_zh: 待上传文件大小，单位为字节。该值记录为附件元数据；请填写实际文件大小
parameters.name: size_bytes

schema.description_en: The standard response for requesting an attachment upload slot. After the PUT upload is complete, Data.FileId can be used as the only file reference in CreateSemanticJob.ReferenceFileIds
schema.description_zh: 申请附件上传槽的标准响应。Data.FileId 在完成 PUT 上传后可作为 CreateSemanticJob.ReferenceFileIds 的唯一文件引用

Data.description_en: The attachment upload slot information. PUT the file to Data.UploadUrl before Data.ExpiresAt, then use Data.FileId to create a single-file semantic task
Data.description_zh: 附件上传槽信息。先在 Data.ExpiresAt 前将文件 PUT 到 Data.UploadUrl，再使用 Data.FileId 创建单文件语义任务

ExpiresAt.description_en: The expiration time of UploadUrl, expressed as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. After this time, call UploadSemanticFile again to request a new URL
ExpiresAt.description_zh: UploadUrl 的过期时间，单位为毫秒的 Unix 时间戳；超过该时间需重新调用 UploadSemanticFile 申请地址

FileId.description_en: The unique identifier of the attachment. After completing the PUT upload to UploadUrl, pass this value to the ReferenceFileIds parameter of CreateSemanticJob
FileId.description_zh: 附件唯一标识。完成对 UploadUrl 的 PUT 上传后，填入 CreateSemanticJob 的 ReferenceFileIds

UploadUrl.description_en: The temporary OSS PUT upload URL. Valid for 30 minutes. Only the specified object can be uploaded. Use the ContentType from the request when performing the PUT request. Do not log or distribute the full URL
UploadUrl.description_zh: 临时 OSS PUT 上传地址，有效期 30 分钟，仅可上传指定对象。请使用请求中的 ContentType 执行 PUT，且不要记录、传播完整 URL

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for locating logs and troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志和排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
